components.name: Pastel sleep reading
components.css: .ds-reading{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;background:var(--sleep-panel,#ded3ff);color:#182027;min-width:0;padding:22px;border-radius:14px;font:400 16px/1.6 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-reading h3{margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;color:#29333e}.ds-reading p{margin:0;font-size:36px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-reading>span{font-size:13px;color:#37414a}.ds-reading button{min-height:44px;padding:7px 0;background:transparent;border:0;color:#26313c;font:500 14px/1.35 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-reading button:hover{color:#07111b;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-reading button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #26313c;outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:560px){.ds-reading{padding:15px 12px;border-radius:12px}.ds-reading p{font-size:30px}.ds-reading button{min-height:44px}}
components.description: One of four selected-day panels: lavender sleep, peach steps, blue resting heart rate, mint energy. Dark ink and complete units stay readable on pastel surfaces; preview shows an actual fixture reading.

narrative.overview: A dark, calm evidence workspace with precise IBM Plex Sans typography, clear readings, and restrained blue navigation. Pastel measurement panels make the selected day the first thing to read; charts and source records provide the context around it. All observations and import details are synthetic; Intelligence calculates locally.
keyCharacteristics: Carbon navigation rail on desktop; horizontally scrolling routes below 1200px.
Four pastel reading panels with dark ink and complete units.
Four-track dated-record coverage calendar; phone readings precede the circle.
Compact aligned Recovery charts with one keyboard entry per plot.
Saved answer dates, named sources, metric scope, and complete inline evidence.

rules.name: Metric continuity
rules.body: Retain metric identity across panels, chart lines, coverage tracks, units, and evidence. Color does not encode health quality.

rules.name: Coverage means records
rules.body: Every circle segment corresponds to a civil date and one measurement. Gaps mean unrecorded or excluded data; tracks are never a health or readiness score.

dos: Do keep dark ink on pastel reading panels and the 16px reading base on phones.
Do distinguish hidden-by-filter measurements from genuinely absent observations.
Do preserve recorded zero, bounded day controls, keyboard chart navigation, and saved answer scope.
Do retain complete inline evidence and readable horizontally scrollable records.
donts: Don't interpret coverage as a health or readiness score or infer causation from association.
Don't present synthetic source rows as live connections or locally calculated answers as live AI.
